about: What the game showed for Eric before the protagonist config (#251), captured from the code and story at 13f71f23. game3d/test/unit/mc-identity.test.mjs checks that Eric still gets exactly this. Day-2 dinner moved indoors in the quality rebuild; removed English replacement subtitle and moved identity lines to izakaya.js.

game3d/story/day2/index.js: Eric! After work. Food. Welcome food!
Eric! This way. Mori-san is there.
Yes! See you Monday, Eric. Computer game also, maybe?
エリックさんは、どちらがいいですか。
game3d/story/day2/office.js: Eric! After work. Food. Welcome food!
game3d/story/day2/shotengai.js: Eric! This way. Mori-san is there.
game3d/story/office.js: Eric-san? I am Kenji! Two months here, so now I am not the newest. Ah, sorry, your chair... I borrowed it. Mine is broken.
Okay, I'm going home. Um... Eric?
You must be Eric. Emi, I run this lot. Sorry I wasn't about, I've been upstairs since seven begging for money.
game3d/story/tickets.js:
The {コピー機|kopiiki|copier} on B2 eats paper during printing. Please check it before we order another one.

Opened 1 April 1996. Closed by Mio after Eric’s test copies came through normally.
game3d/story/train.js: Mm, like that. Don't worry, it's not mean, it's like saying “the new guy”. Only, you stay new guy for, um, maybe ten years.
